payload.title: File:Plumadraco bankoorum (elongated feather details).png
payload.credit_html: "Hyperelongate ornamental tail feathers in a new early Cretaceous enantiornithine bird"
payload.description_html: (A) Photograph of the rachis-dominated feathers of the Plumadraco bankoorum holotype (STM11−40), (B) finely-preserved structures present in the proximal portion of the right RDF of Plumadraco, and (C) the preserved racket showing the differentiated barbs and the reduction, and eventual complete termination, of the central support structures (i.e., ramus and medial stripe).
